create_grammar_sampler: create a GrammarSampler instance with a grammar string and tokenizer for grammar-constrained token sampling
reset_grammar_sampler: reset the GrammarSampler internal state and sampled tokens before starting a new generation
set_grammar: set a new grammar string on the GrammarSampler while reusing the existing trie to avoid recomputing
constrained_sample_from_logits: sample tokens from logits constrained by the grammar using a provided sampling function
review_grammar_sampler_class: review the GrammarSampler class and its methods for grammar-constrained token generation
